newsitem.title: USA: Motorola says court denies request.
newsitem.headline: Motorola says court denies request.

text.p: A federal court of appeals denied a request by InterDigital Communications Corp for a new trial regarding patent infringement litigation with Motorola Inc, Motorola said on Thursday.
In a press statement, Motorola said the ruling leaves intact a 1995 jury finding that none of the Motorola products involved in the litigation infringe InterDigital patents.
However, the court also overturned the jury's finding that two claims of InterDigital's patents were invalid.

Susan Sutton, a spokeswoman for InterDigital, said the company had not ruled out the possibility of filing new suits based on the court's decision, which she said strenghthened the validity of two InterDigital patents.
"We have to make some strategic decisions," Sutton told Reuters.
Motorola provides wireless communications, semiconductors and electronic systems; InterDigital develops wireless telecommunications systems.
